notes.title: New update released
notes.content:
We released a new update with some bug fixes, gameplay improvements and more, have fun!

1. Bug when trying to close the game with gamepad/keyboard clicks.
2. Map piece spawned in one section when not playing a map level.
3. Added timer counter to flying zones.
4. Reduced running achievement to 500,000m.
5. Reduced speed boost achievement to 250 boosts.
6. Fixed all upgrade achievement not triggering.
7. Fixed last boss battle achievement not triggering.
8. Fixed 3 boss in one run achievement not triggering.
9. Zoomed out the main camera for a wider viewport and more reaction time.
10. Fixed gates 34-35 order.
11. Fixed level 37 goal for 2 and 3 stars.
12. Reduced lightnings level goal to 10.

And more...

notes.title: Update version 1.12.00
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37364821/9c92817f26ccfa543dd3f4af9ad1d93fa8c62300.png[/img]
We just released a new update, version 1.12.00.
[olist]
[*]The game will now pause automatically, if the window loses focus.
[*]Deleting saved files option didn't work.
[*]Bug with magnet pickup, continued pulling coins after timer finished.
[*]Buying shields is now available only on level 12+
[*]Windowed concrete platform updated design.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update version 1.11.10
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37364821/9c92817f26ccfa543dd3f4af9ad1d93fa8c62300.png[/img]
We just release our first update, version 1.11.10.
The new update includes some of your suggestions and reports, keep em coming!
[olist]
[*]New achievement for finishing all mission levels with 3 stars rating.
[*]Magnet indicator now appears on top of the player instead of top right UI.
[*]Store upgrade buttons were still clickable when out of frame.
[*]Removed fireball timescale slow motion effect.
[*]Secondary jump button is now also used to start playing a mission level.
[*]Added sound effect for picking up map pieces.
[*]Jump could be initiated when the game is paused, make you unable to jump after resuming play.
[*]Music stopped when moving to the next level.
[*]Pressing the play button to start the missions registered as a jump.
[*]Fixed castle message text position.
[*]Fixed spikes on green hills wrong position.
[*]Moved new high score message icon to the top of the screen.
[*]Exit game icon switched faces expression.
[/olist]
